tips.text: Hit a lone enemy with Obliterate for extra damage. Aim it so only one champion is caught, and avoid hitting minions with it in a trade.
Land Obliterate and Death's Grasp on champions to build Darkness Rise quickly, then stay on top of them while the aura ticks.
Trade first, then press Indestructible. It stores damage you deal and take, so a shield is bigger after fighting.
Recast Indestructible while the shield is still up to turn what is left into health.
Use Death's Grasp to drag enemies toward you, especially ones backing away from your aura. It also pulls several enemies at once.
Use Realm of Death on a low-health enemy to secure the kill. Their teammates can't help them inside.
Use Death's Grasp to pull Aatrox back to you when he backs away after a trade, then follow with Obliterate.
Hit Aatrox alone with Obliterate, away from minions, so it hits harder.
Press Indestructible just before Aatrox's hits land, then recast it for health when the shield is mostly spent.
Fight Aatrox when Darkness Rise is active; stay close so its aura keeps burning him, since he can't easily out-trade it.
Save Realm of Death for Aatrox once you reach level 6; it cuts him off from his team and stops him from healing off others.
Step sideways out of Infernal Chains, or walk toward Aatrox, so you aren't pulled back.
Hold Death's Grasp for when Akali steps close to trade or flips in; it pulls her back into your reach and starts Darkness Rise.
Use Realm of Death on Akali when she is low or has used her escapes; nobody can help her in the Death Realm.
Press Indestructible during a trade to absorb her burst. Recast it to heal once her damage is done.
Hit Akali with Obliterate when she is alone in front of you; it deals extra damage to a single target.
Fight when Akali is low on energy. She cannot spam Five Point Strike, so you can walk up and trade.
Hold Death's Grasp until Ambessa dashes in or walks up to trade; it pulls her into your Darkness Rise aura.
Press Indestructible when you start trading. It stores damage from both sides, so a long fight leaves you with a bigger shield.
Hit Ambessa with Obliterate while she is alone. It deals more damage to a single target, so keep minions out of the hit.
Land Obliterate and Death's Grasp on her to build Darkness Rise quickly. Then stay on her so the aura keeps burning.
At level 6, use Realm of Death on Ambessa when she is low. It keeps her allies out, and she cannot escape the fight easily.
Hit her with Death's Grasp to pull her into your aura. She has few ways to get away once you are on her.
Hit her with Obliterate when she is alone; it deals more damage against a single enemy. Hitting her also builds Darkness Rise.
Take the damage from her spells and fight back. Indestructible turns what you deal and take into a shield.
Walk around Crystallize or wait for it to melt. Do not run into it when you chase her.
Use Realm of Death on her at level 6 and fight her away from her egg. She cannot dodge once you are inside.
Land Death's Grasp when Aurora steps up to trade; it pulls her toward you so you can hit her with Obliterate.
Use Realm of Death on Aurora after she spends Across the Veil; she has less to escape with and cannot get help from her team.
Hit Aurora with Obliterate when she is alone in the lane; it deals more damage to a single target.
Press Indestructible after you have traded for a while; a bigger shield comes from fighting, and recasting it heals you.
Stay close once Darkness Rise is active; its aura hurts her if she is next to you, and she is slowed when she tries to back off.
Hold Realm of Death for Briar once she commits with Certain Death or Blood Frenzy; banishing her takes away her teammates and her healing from your fight.
Use Death's Grasp to pull Briar back to you when she tries to leave, then follow up with Obliterate.
Use Indestructible just before Briar lands Head Rush so the shield soaks her burst, then fight back.
Hit Briar alone with Obliterate, away from minions, so it deals its bonus damage to a single target.
Stay close to Briar once Darkness Rise is active; its aura keeps hurting her while she tries to heal.
Hit Camille with Death's Grasp when she dashes or sits still on a wall; it pulls her into your reach for a trade.
Stay out of her Tactical Sweep outer edge; getting slowed there lets her hit hard and heal.
Use Obliterate when only Camille is in range, so it hits harder on a single target.
Press Indestructible just before she stuns you or trades, then recast it to heal back some damage.
Use Realm of Death on Camille at level 6. She can't be helped, and her Hextech Ultimatum can't trap you in the Death Realm.
Stay out of the smoke cloud Rupture leaves on the ground; step aside before it lands so you are not knocked up.
Pull Cho'Gath in with Death's Grasp when he steps up to last-hit, then hit him with Obliterate while he is alone.
Keep out of Feral Scream's short range, or you are silenced and cannot use your abilities.
Fight him in longer trades so your Indestructible shield grows, and recast it to heal.
Do not let him eat minions freely; deny his growth and look to hit him early.
Stay out of Apprehend's cone, because being pulled in lets Darius hit you and stack Hemorrhage. Sidestep it.
Fight when Apprehend is on cooldown. Darius then has a hard time reaching you, so you can trade freely.
Use Death's Grasp to pull Darius into your aura, then follow with Obliterate while he is alone.
Press Indestructible when Darius starts a fight, then recast it to heal back some of the damage you took.
Land three hits to switch on Darius's weakness: your Darkness Rise aura. It hurts him when he stays close.
Walk out of Decimate's edge range, since the handle hits weaker. Hit him back while it winds up.
Save Realm of Death for when Darius is low or his stacks are high. Inside, Noxian Guillotine cannot reach you.
Hit Obliterate while Mundo is alone, away from minions, for extra damage.
Death's Grasp pulls Mundo in. Rooting him is wasted, since his passive resists the first immobilizing effect, so use it to start a fight after that is gone.
Step on the canister Mundo drops to destroy it, so he can't heal from it.
Use Indestructible when Mundo's Heart Zapper starts, then trade so your shield absorbs his damage. Fight and build the shield before he recasts it.
Keep Realm of Death for when Mundo is low. It cuts him off from help, and Mundo can't recast Maximum Dosage until it ends.
Dodge Infected Bonesaw, since being slowed lets him close the gap and trade.
Bait Riposte before you use Death's Grasp. If it lands while she parries, she is not pulled and gets to stun you instead.
Wait for Fiora to spend Riposte before you cast Realm of Death on her. Her parry will cancel it, and the ultimate goes on cooldown.
Hit Fiora and her minions with Obliterate to build Darkness Rise. Then stay on top of her, because the aura works best when she is close.
Use Indestructible as you trade, since the shield stores the damage you deal. Recast it to heal when the fight is nearly over.
Land Death's Grasp when Gangplank walks up to a keg or to hit a minion; it pulls him into your Obliterate.
Hit Gangplank with abilities and attacks to get Darkness Rise running, then stay on him, since his poke is weaker against a fast aura.
Use Obliterate when only Gangplank is in range; it hits harder against a single enemy.
Press Indestructible when kegs are about to blow; the shield soaks the burst, and recasting heals you.
Gangplank can clear your Death's Grasp stun-free with Remove Scurvy, so look for the grab when it is on cooldown.
Use Realm of Death on Gangplank to cut him off from his kegs and his ship's help; he cannot Cannon Barrage you out of it.
Pull Garen in with Death's Grasp, then hit him with Obliterate while he is alone. A lone target takes extra damage.
Fight when Garen has just taken damage. His healing from Perseverance stops for a while after you hit him.
Press Indestructible after trading so the damage you dealt turns into a shield. Recast it to heal.
Hit Garen with two spells and an attack to switch on Darkness Rise. Then stay next to him so the aura keeps hurting him.
Use Realm of Death on Garen when he is low. His Demacian Justice cannot reach you inside, and you can take his stats.
Do not let Garen spin on you in melee for long. Judgment hurts a lot and cuts your armor.
Hit Gnar with Death's Grasp when he hops in or stands at range; it pulls him to you so you can start Darkness Rise.
Hitting Gnar with a basic attack and two abilities quickly turns on Darkness Rise, so trade when he is close and keep hitting him.
Use Obliterate when only Gnar is in range, since it hits harder against a single enemy.
Press Indestructible after trading damage so the shield is bigger, then recast it to heal back some health.
Mega Gnar is slow and tough, so do not fight him alone. Back off until he turns small again.
Save Realm of Death for Gnar when he is Mega, or low on health, so you can finish him away from his team.
Stay out of Barrel Roll when it goes off. It slows you more the longer it has waited.
Hit Gragas with Obliterate when he is alone near you. It hits harder against a single target.
Use Indestructible when you trade with Gragas. Your shield grows from damage you deal, so keep fighting to build it.
Don't chase Gragas far. Body Slam has a short cooldown and gets him out when he lands it.
Land three hits on Gragas to turn on Darkness Rise. Combine Death's Grasp and Obliterate to get there fast.
Pull Gwen in with Death's Grasp when she steps up to hit minions, then follow with Obliterate while she is alone.
Hold Indestructible until Gwen commits to a trade, so the shield has stored damage and absorbs her burst.
Stay close and keep hitting her so Darkness Rise turns on. Its aura hurts her when she stands next to you.
Do not waste Realm of Death while Hallowed Mist is up; wait until she is not protected, then use it to kill her.
Hit Gwen with Death's Grasp after she uses Skip 'n Slash. She cannot dash away and is pulled back to you.
Land Death's Grasp to pull Heimerdinger away from his turrets, then fight him there.
Hit Heimerdinger with Obliterate when he is alone; it deals extra damage to a single target.
Walk up when his grenade is on cooldown; it is his main stun and escape.
Use Realm of Death on Heimerdinger to cut him off from his turrets. Nothing outside can help him.
Hit him with abilities to get Darkness Rise running, then press on. Trading builds your Indestructible shield.
Pull Illaoi out of her Tentacles with Death's Grasp, then fight her away from the terrain where they spawn.
Take your fights early and keep trading, so Indestructible has a big shield to absorb her burst.
If Illaoi pulls your spirit out with Test of Spirit, hit her. Damaging her cuts the spirit's time short.
Use Realm of Death on Illaoi to fight her alone, away from every Tentacle.
Land Obliterate on Illaoi alone, not on a minion wave, because it hits harder against a single target.
Hit Irelia with Death's Grasp when she dashes in or lines up behind a minion. Pulling her to you sets up your Obliterate.
Fight Irelia when no minions are near. Without them Bladesurge has nothing to dash to, so she has trouble getting in and out.
Land Obliterate on Irelia when she is alone, with no minions beside her. It deals more damage to a single target.
Hold your big damage while Irelia charges Defiant Dance. Wait until it ends, then hit her.
Move out of the way of her Flawless Duet blades, because being stunned by it lets her kill you. Keep your distance from the blades.
Save Realm of Death for Irelia once she is low or has used her dashes. Nobody can help her in there.
Trade with Irelia while Indestructible has built up a shield from your hits. Use it when she goes all in on you.
Do not auto-attack Jax while Counter Strike is up; wait it out, then fight when he is stunned or out of his stance.
Pull Jax in with Death's Grasp after he commits his dash, then hit him with Obliterate while he is alone.
Build up Indestructible by trading, and use it when Jax jumps on you.
Jax gets stronger the longer he keeps hitting you, so use Realm of Death to cut off his Relentless Assault fight and take him alone.
Hit Death's Grasp on Jayce when he swaps to hammer and steps in; it pulls him straight into your reach.
Trade with Obliterate when only Jayce is near, since it hits harder against a lone target. Keep minions out of the line.
Hit Jayce with two attacks or spells and a minion or other champion for Darkness Rise. Then stay on him so the aura hurts.
Press Indestructible after you have taken poke or traded, then recast it to heal back some of the shield.
At level 6, use Realm of Death on Jayce to cut him off from help. His Shock Blast and Thundering Blow are of little use to him inside.
Hit K'Sante with Obliterate when he is alone in front of you; it hits harder against a single enemy.
Use Indestructible when you trade; the damage you deal and take builds the shield, so fight first and cast it mid-trade.
Pull K'Sante in with Death's Grasp when he walks up to trade, then follow with Obliterate.
Land three hits to switch on Darkness Rise, then stay close. Its aura keeps hurting him while he is near you.
Realm of Death on K'Sante once he is low, or when he has used his stun. He cannot get help inside, and you keep his stats if he dies.
Fight Kayle early and hard, before she reaches level 6 and gets her range.
Land Death's Grasp to pull Kayle into you, then hit her with Obliterate while she is alone.
Use Indestructible when you trade with Kayle to absorb her poke. Damage you deal also feeds the shield.
Use Realm of Death on Kayle when she is low or after she has used her escape. Nobody can save her inside.
Kayle's Divine Judgment makes her or an ally immune for a short time. Hold your damage until it ends, but stay close so you can still chase her.
Hit Kennen with Death's Grasp when he steps up to poke; it drags him to you so you can fight him up close.
Hit Kennen with Obliterate when he is alone in the lane; it hits harder against a single enemy.
Press Indestructible when Kennen is about to land his third Mark of the Storm, or in the middle of a trade, to soak up his damage.
Use Realm of Death on Kennen at level 6 when he is low. He is flimsy, and in there he cannot escape you.
Stay close to Kennen once Darkness Rise is active; its aura keeps hurting him while he tries to run.
Hit Death's Grasp when Kled walks up to the wave; it pulls him into your Darkness Rise aura and Obliterate.
Hit Kled with Obliterate when no minions are near him; it deals bonus damage to a single target.
Press Indestructible after a trade to turn the damage you dealt into a shield. Recast it to heal when you are hurt.
Once Kled is off his mount, he cannot use Jousting, so push in and fight him then.
Use Realm of Death on Kled when he is low or when you are alone with him. His teammates cannot help him inside.
Walk out of Seismic Shard range when you can; the slow ruins your chase and gives Malphite speed.
Land Death's Grasp to pull Malphite into your Obliterate, then hit him by himself for the bonus damage.
Hit Malphite with abilities to build Darkness Rise fast, then stay on him; the aura beats his tankiness over time.
Hold Indestructible for when Malphite goes for his Thunderclap trade; the shield soaks it, and recast to heal.
Malphite's Unstoppable Force knocks you up and cannot be stopped; stay spread from allies and keep Indestructible ready at level 6.
Aim Death's Grasp at Naafiri when she dashes in or backs away; it pulls her back to you into your damage aura.
Use Obliterate when only Naafiri is in range, away from her Packmates; it hits harder against a single enemy.
Press Indestructible when you see her commit to a trade; the shield grows from the damage you deal and take, and the recast heals you.
Use Realm of Death on Naafiri at level 6. Her Packmates cannot follow, so you fight her alone and she can't be saved by her team.
Land a few hits on her to start Darkness Rise, then stay close and fight; she has to trade into your aura.
Hit Nasus with Obliterate when he is alone near a minion wave; it hits harder against a single target.
Hit him with Death's Grasp to pull him into your Darkness Rise aura and Obliterate, then fight while the aura is active.
Do not let Nasus farm for free. Harass him when he goes for a Siphoning Strike last hit so his stacks stay low.
Trade when Wither is on cooldown. Once it is on you, its slow grows over time, so fight early or back off.
Take fights with Indestructible ready; its shield grows with the damage you deal and take, and recasting it heals you.
Save Realm of Death for when Nasus has used Fury of the Sands or is low on Health; it takes him away from his team.
Land Death's Grasp to pull Olaf in, then hit him with Obliterate while he is alone.
Do not use Realm of Death on Olaf while Ragnarok is active, since he is immune to disables then. Wait until it ends.
Stay away from Olaf's axe on the ground, since he uses it to throw Undertow again quickly and slow you.
Trade with Indestructible ready; the shield soaks his damage and the recast heals you.
Do not leave Olaf at low health; he hits harder and heals more. Finish him quickly or back off.
Stay out of wall range when Ornn has Searing Charge ready; hitting terrain next to you gets you knocked up and stunned.
Hit Ornn with Obliterate when he is alone with no minions near him; it hits harder against a single target.
Use Death's Grasp to pull Ornn out of position, then follow with Obliterate and attacks to start Darkness Rise.
Trade with Indestructible up so you can soak his poke and then break his hits with the shield.
Realm of Death on Ornn cuts him off from his team, so his crowd control combos with allies cannot reach you inside.
Hit Pantheon with Obliterate when he is alone in front of you; it does extra damage to a single target.
Pull Pantheon in with Death's Grasp when he tries to leave, then fight him while he is close.
Don't swing at Pantheon while he braces Aegis Assault facing you; step around to his side or wait it out.
Press Indestructible after taking Pantheon's stun and trade; the shield soaks his follow-up hits.
Use Realm of Death on Pantheon in a fight; no one can help him and he can't jump to allies.
Pull Quinn in with Death's Grasp when she walks up to farm, then follow with Obliterate while she is alone with you.
Hit Quinn with Obliterate when no minions are near her; it hurts more against a single enemy.
Trade when Quinn has used Vault; she has fewer ways to get away. Build Darkness Rise by hitting her with abilities and attacks, then stay on her.
Use Indestructible when Quinn's Blinding Assault or Vault is about to land, then recast it to heal after the trade.
At level 6, use Realm of Death on Quinn to take her away from her team. She cannot dodge it with Vault once it has begun.
Stay out of melee range of Renekton when his Fury is high; Ruthless Predator will stun you for longer.
Use Death's Grasp to pull Renekton back after he dashes in, so he can't escape.
Hit Renekton with Obliterate when he is alone; it deals more damage to a single target.
Fight back to build Indestructible, then activate it when Renekton trades.
Use Realm of Death on Renekton at level 6 to cut him off from his Fury and his team.
Hold Indestructible for when Riven jumps in with Ki Burst; the shield soaks her burst and the recast heals you back.
Use Death's Grasp to yank Riven back when she dashes away, then follow with Obliterate.
Hit Riven with Obliterate while she is alone with you; it deals more damage against a single enemy.
Take Riven into Realm of Death at level 6 when she is low; her teammates cannot help her and her Valor dashes stay inside the arena.
Stay in close once Darkness Rise is active; its aura keeps hurting Riven while she tries to dance in and out.
Aim Obliterate so it hits only Rumble, not minions beside him, for extra damage.
Use Death's Grasp to pull Rumble into your reach, then fight with your passive up.
Trade hard before using Indestructible so the shield is big. Use it when Rumble's spells are about to land.
Attack Rumble when he is Overheating. He can't cast spells, but his basic attacks still hit hard.
Fight in Rumble's burning trail from The Equalizer only if you must. It slows you and does steady damage, so step out of it.
Hit Sett with Death's Grasp when he steps in to trade; it pulls him toward you into your Darkness Rise aura.
Use Indestructible when Sett hits you hard in a trade. It turns the damage into a shield, and recasting it heals you.
Land three hits on Sett to start Darkness Rise. Obliterate and Death's Grasp both count, so open with them.
Use Obliterate when Sett is the only enemy it hits. It hits harder against a single target.
Save Realm of Death for when Sett is low or you want a safe duel. No one can help him while he is cut off from his team.
Walk out of Shen's Shadow Dash line when he aims at you. If he misses, hit him with Obliterate while he is out of position.
Use Death's Grasp to pull Shen back toward you when he tries to walk away. Follow up with Obliterate while he is close.
Fight Shen when your allies are not near. Obliterate hits harder when Shen is the only enemy it hits, and he is isolated.
Hit Shen with abilities and attacks to build up Darkness Rise, then stay close so its aura keeps hurting him.
Trade first, then press Indestructible to turn the damage you dealt into a shield. Recast it to heal once Shen's damage runs out.
Save Realm of Death for when Shen tries to teleport to an ally with Stand United. Inside the Death Realm he can't leave.
Dodge Singed's Mega Adhesive, or he can Fling you into it and root you.
Use Death's Grasp to pull Singed back when he runs away through his Poison Trail.
Hit Singed with Obliterate while he is alone; it does more damage to a single target.
Build up Indestructible by trading with Singed, then use it when his poison is ticking on you.
At level 6, use Realm of Death on Singed so his allies and his trail cannot help him.
Keep Obliterate aimed at Sion alone when you can; it hits harder against one isolated target.
Stay out of Decimating Smash range while Sion charges. A long charge means a long stun, so step aside when you see it.
Don't use Realm of Death on Sion while Glory in Death is active. It does nothing to him then.
Use Indestructible when Sion's Soul Furnace is about to blow, so his burst hits your shield.
Pull Sion in with Death's Grasp, then hit him with Obliterate to start Darkness Rise.
Land Death's Grasp to pull Tahm Kench into your Obliterate and Darkness Rise; hitting both builds Darkness Rise fast.
Use Obliterate when only Tahm Kench is in range, since it hits harder against a single enemy.
Press Indestructible after you trade, so the damage you dealt becomes a shield. Recast it to heal if you are low.
Step out of the line of Tongue Lash. Taking a hit leaves you slowed, and a third stack makes it stun you.
When Tahm Kench channels Abyssal Dive, step away from the spot where he will land, or he will knock you up.
Tahm Kench can shield with Thick Skin. Trade while it is down, or hold your burst until the shield fades.
Realm of Death on Tahm Kench removes the enemy's allies and the jungler, so you can fight him one on one.
Close the gap right after you land Death's Grasp. It pulls Teemo toward you and gives you a chance to start Darkness Rise.
Watch for Teemo hiding in brush. Walk around it, because Noxious Trap mushrooms are stealthed and he sets them there.
Use Indestructible in the middle of a trade, once your shield has stored damage from Teemo's poke. Recast it to heal.
Obliterate hits harder when only one enemy is hit, so use it on Teemo when no minions are in the way.
Save Realm of Death for level 6 to cut Teemo off from his mushrooms and his escape. He can't use his mushrooms against you inside it.
Blinding Dart makes your basic attacks miss, so back off while you're blinded and use Obliterate instead.
Hit Tryndamere with several abilities to charge Darkness Rise quickly, then stay on him while the aura burns.
Use Obliterate on him when he is alone with no minions near him; it hits harder against a single enemy.
Wait out Undying Rage before using Realm of Death; he can't be killed while it lasts.
Pull Tryndamere with Death's Grasp when he stays close to your minions, so you get free hits on him.
Press Indestructible after trading to bank a shield, then recast it to heal if his Spinning Slash catches you.
Hit Obliterate on Urgot when he is alone, without minions near him. It hits harder against a single enemy.
Pull Urgot in with Death's Grasp, then hit him with Obliterate.
Watch for Disdain; its stun hurts most when you are walking up to him. Hold Indestructible if you cannot dodge it.
Save Realm of Death for when Urgot is low on health. Alone in there he cannot use Fear Beyond Death.
Walk up and land Death's Grasp to pull Varus into your range, then hit him with Obliterate. He is much weaker once you are on top of him.
Stay out of a charged Piercing Arrow's line. Step sideways or stay near minions, because Varus can fire it from very long range.
Press Indestructible after trading some damage so the shield soaks his poke. Recast it to heal if the shield is not used up.
Land Obliterate on Varus when he is alone, with no minions in the hit area. It hits harder against a single target.
Use Realm of Death on Varus at level 6 when he is low or has used his escapes. His ultimate and allies cannot help him inside.
Do not fight inside the ground patch from Hail of Arrows. It leaves you slowed.
Hit Vayne with Death's Grasp to pull her into your aura. She is fragile and cannot stay up for long once close.
Do not stand with your back to a wall when Vayne is near. Condemn will stun you if it knocks you into terrain.
Use Obliterate on Vayne when she is alone near you for more damage. Hitting only her with it makes it hit harder.
Use Realm of Death on Vayne to cut her off from help. She has no one to peel her and cannot easily kite you.
Use Indestructible when Vayne is about to trade with you; it blunts her Silver Bolts and attacks.
Hit Vladimir with Obliterate when he is alone in the area; it hurts more against a single target.
Land Death's Grasp to pull Vladimir in, then fight him close so Darkness Rise starts working.
Press Indestructible after trading with Vladimir; the damage you dealt becomes a bigger shield. Recast it to heal.
Wait out Sanguine Pool before you attack, because Vladimir cannot be targeted while in it. Do not stay inside the pool, as it slows you.
Use Realm of Death on Vladimir at level 6 when he is low. His allies and his Hemoplague cannot reach you in there.
Pull Volibear back with Death's Grasp when he leaps in or tries to run off. It lands after a short delay, so aim where he is heading.
Use Obliterate when only Volibear is hit, such as with no minions in the way. It hits harder against an isolated target.
Hit Volibear with three attacks or spells to switch on Darkness Rise, then stay next to him so the aura keeps burning.
Press Indestructible after trading, once you have stored a lot of damage. Recast it to heal when the shield is about to run out.
Use Realm of Death on Volibear at level 6. In the Death Realm he cannot use his teammates or turret dives, and you steal his stats.
Pull Xin Zhao back with Death's Grasp when he runs at you, then follow with Obliterate while he is alone.
Fight him until Darkness Rise is active, then stay close; the aura keeps hurting him while he trades.
Press Indestructible when Xin Zhao starts his Three Talon Strike combo; the shield soaks it, and recast it to heal afterward.
Aim Obliterate at Xin Zhao when no minions are next to him; it does bonus damage to a lone target.
Use Realm of Death on Xin Zhao once he is low. His Crescent Guard cannot save him there, as nobody else can reach you.
Aim Death's Grasp at Yasuo when he dashes or stands in a line with minions; it pulls him to you so you can follow up with Obliterate.
Use Obliterate when only Yasuo is in its path, away from minions, so it hits harder as a single target.
Press Indestructible after you have traded for a while, not before; it stores damage you deal and take, so a fuller bar gives a bigger shield.
Stay close and keep hitting him to turn on Darkness Rise; its aura hurts him every second he stands near you.
Use Realm of Death on Yasuo at level 6 when you can fight him alone; his Wind Wall cannot help him there and he is slowed as you cast.
Death's Grasp is a projectile, so wait until Wind Wall is on cooldown before you throw it.
Aim Death's Grasp at Yone when he steps in to trade; it pulls him toward you, so you can follow up with Obliterate.
Hit Yone with Obliterate while no minions are next to him; it hits harder against a lone target.
Trade with Yone before using Indestructible, because the shield grows from the damage you deal and take. Press it when his big hits come.
Land three hits on Yone to turn on Darkness Rise, then stay on him. Its aura keeps hurting him while he stands close.
Use Realm of Death on Yone to cut off his shield and escape tools. Fight him straight up inside; you keep his stolen stats if he dies there.
Hit Yorick with Obliterate when he is alone, with no Mist Walkers next to him. It deals more damage to a single target.
Use Death's Grasp to pull Yorick out of his Dark Procession wall or away from his Mist Walkers, then fight him while he is separated from them.
Trade by hitting Yorick with several attacks and spells so Darkness Rise turns on. Then stay next to him, because its aura keeps damaging him.
Press Indestructible after you have traded to turn the damage you dealt into a shield. Recast it to heal when you are low.
Use Realm of Death on Yorick in a fight. His Maiden and Mist Walkers cannot reach you inside, so it is a fair one-on-one.
Pull Zaahen into your range with Death's Grasp, then follow with Obliterate while he is alone so it hits harder.
Press Indestructible when he starts a trade, after you have dealt and taken some damage, so the shield is bigger.
Do not use Realm of Death to finish him when he has just built up a full bar of stacks under his health bar. He can revive and the fight drags on.
Realm of Death gives you a private duel with him. Use it when he has no allies near and you are ahead, since he cannot flee easily.
Hit him with abilities and attacks quickly to turn on Darkness Rise. Its aura hurts him more the longer he stays next to you.
